Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2705-07 West Augusta Boulevard, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: Approximately 6,125 square feet
2707 W. Augusta Blvd..: 3,000 square feet
2705 W. Augusta Blvd. : 3,125 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant intends to divide the zoning lot into two (2) separate zoning
lots so the newly created zoning lot at 2705 West Augusta Boulevard can
be developed with a new four-story three (3) dwelling unit residential
building. The proposed building will measure approximately 44 ft.-10 in. in
height and be supported by three (3) off-street parking spaces. The height
and footprint of the existing multi-unit residential building at 2707 West
Augusta Boulevard will remain without change. The subject property is a
Transit Served Location based on its proximity to the CTA Chicago Avenue
Bus Line Corridor. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE, 17-13-
1101-B, and 17-13-1003-K of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant
is seeking to reduce the off-street parking requirement for 2707 West
Augusta Boulevard from three (3) parking spaces to two (2) parking spaces,
for 2705 West Augusta Boulevard increase the off-street parking ratio for a
Transit Served Location from 66.6% (2 parking spaces) to 100% (3 parking
spaces), reduce the front setback to 10 fi., reduce the rear setback to 21 ft.-
6 in., waive the rear yard open space requirement, and is seeking all zoning
relief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the
attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio:
a. 2707 W. Augusta Blvd.: Existing to remain
b. 2705 W. Augusta Blvd.: 5,310 square feet (1.7 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.):
a. 2707 W. Augusta Blvd.: 1,000 square feet per D.U.
(3 residential units)
b. 2705 W. Augusta Blvd.: 1,041.67 square feet per D.U.
(3 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking:
a. *2707 W. Augusta Blvd.; 2 parking spaces
b. *2705 W. Augusta Blvd.: 3 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location based on its
proximity to the CTA Chicago Avenue Bus Line Corridor. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-
1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking requirement from
three (3) parking spaces to two (2) parking spaces 2707 W. August Blvd. and
